summary: @servicetitan/startup preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's declared preinstall script runs `node setup.mjs`, which is itself an obfuscator.io-style renamed dropper (hex `_0x...` identifiers, per-function string maps). setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` at the package root. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle obfuscated with a numeric-constant array plus rotation function and meaningless identifiers, not referenced from `main`/`dist`, not listed in `package.json.files`, and not mentioned in the README. The package is publicly advertised as a Lerna/TypeScript CLI scaffolder and has no documented need for a Bun runtime or a math-themed binary blob. Installing the package causes the obfuscated payload to run on the installer's host under an alternate runtime, bypassing Node-only scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
